what: Noise that holds a random level and only changes at a set rate: stepped random values, or gritty buzz when fast.
how: A new random value is picked at the RATE and held until the next one. At a few times a second you get a random staircase to use as control, like a sample-and-hold. At audio rates it turns into a buzzy, pitched-sounding noise.

ins.rate: A control signal that changes the speed. Each 1.0 of signal doubles the RATE (an octave).
ins.sync: A pulse that restarts the cycle and picks a new value now. Patch CLOCK here to make the steps follow the beat.

outs.out: The stepped noise, up to plus or minus LEVEL. Use it as audio or as a control signal.

knobs.rate: How often a new value is picked, 0.1 to 20000 times a second. Slow gives steps; fast gives a gritty tone.
knobs.level: The size of the output, 0 to 1.

try: Patch CLOCK's 8th into STEPNOISE's sync, STEPNOISE's out into SVF's cutoff (CV about the middle), VCO into SVF's in and SVF's lp into OUT. The filter jumps to a new random setting on each beat.
